slides.headline: She grew up in a Telangana village. In September 2026, she became mayor of an Australian city.
Sandhya 'Sandy' Reddy was elected Mayor of Strathfield Council, Sydney, on September 29, 2026
slides.body: Born in Telangana, India, she moved to Australia in 1991 after completing her education at Stanley College and Osmania University in Hyderabad. She now works as a migration and education consultant.

slides.headline: She built her political career step by step - elected councillor in 2021, Deputy Mayor in 2023, and now mayor.
slides.body: Among the first Indian-origin mayors elected in Australia, her path shows how local government representation for Indian-origin leaders abroad is being built from the ground up, not handed down.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when Indian-origin leaders run city councils, not just corporate boardrooms.
slides.body: Reddy's path from a Telangana village to a Sydney mayor's office is a reminder that Indian-origin success abroad increasingly shows up in municipal government, close to where people actually live.
